summary: Batch template importer caused priority weighting flip and duplicate template IDs, inflating internal alert volume
description: Issue summary: A scheduled bulk import of support templates (escalation templates + conditional priority expressions) during the nightly maintenance window produced a set of templates with duplicated internal IDs and erroneous priority values. Impact: ~23% increase in P1 internal alerts between 02:10-02:30 UTC on 2026-03-09, multiple oncall pages triggered, and internal reporting shows doubled counts for a subset of routing buckets. Observed behavior: importer created templates with duplicated "template_id" values (UUID collisions) and parsed numeric priority expressions as strings which, after downstream normalization, resulted in extremely high numeric weights (default fallback applied). Expected behavior: each template should have a unique ID and priority expressions should be validated and normalized to the configured numeric range. Immediate mitigation: rolled importer back to snapshot v2026-03-08 and suspended scheduled batch imports until a fix is deployed. This ticket tracks the RCA, hotfix, and reporting reconciliation.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Run batch_importer v2.4.1 against templates CSV containing mixed locale numeric formats (e.g., '1,000' vs '1000') in parallel (shards=8). 2) Observe generated template IDs in support-templates table; note duplicates. 3) Trigger routing simulation; observe priority weights showing extreme values and routing to oncall. 4) Re-run with strict-parse flag to see validation errors. Note: reproduction requires parallelism and CSV with at least one conditional expression using comma as thousands separator.
logs_and_metrics:
- support-importer logs: import_worker[7] ERROR: "template insert conflict: duplicate key value" at 2026-03-09T02:12:43Z.
- support-alerts-dashboard: P1-count spike +23% at 02:10-02:30 UTC.
- DB slow queries: elevated locks on support-templates table during import window.
- sample stack trace + link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/commit/4f2b9a2 (importer run id: batch-20260309-01)
investigation_notes: Initial hypotheses: (A) UUID generator had a regression causing truncated UUIDs under high parallelism; (B) CSV parser locale handling turned thousand-separated numbers into strings; (C) downstream normalizer treated non-numeric priority as NaN and applied fallback max-weight (10000). Current findings: importer was updated in PR #8142 to a new UUID function that trimmed entropy for dedup stabilization but introduced collisions when shards > 4. Also, a CSV parsing library bump removed automatic numeric coercion for specific locale formats. Evidence: compare hashes in batch-20260309-01 vs snapshot v2026-03-08, and reproduced collision locally by running importer with shards=8. Correlation with reporting inflation: duplicate template IDs cause reporting pipeline to count templates twice; priority fallback amplified routing to oncall.
temporary_mitigation: 1) Reverted importer to snapshot v2026-03-08 (rollback deployed 2026-03-09T04:05Z). 2) Suspended nightly batch imports until validation gates added. 3) Manual dedupe on support-templates table performed: removed 128 duplicate rows and re-indexed primary key. 4) Oncall notified and false-positive alerts suppressed where possible.
permanent_fix_plan: - Backout problematic UUID change and restore high-entropy generator with proper collision checks (PR #8228). - Add strict numeric parsing and validation to CSV import pipeline; fail import on unparseable priority expressions. - Add preflight dry-run with duplicate-detection and shard-safety check. - Add unit/e2e tests that simulate shards > 4 and localized numeric formatting. Target deploy: 2026-03-13. Owner: platform-import team.
resolution: Partial mitigation applied (rollback + manual dedupe). Full fix PR (#8228) merged and staged in canary as of 2026-03-12; scheduled global rollout pending final verification. Reporting reconciliation in progress to correct inflated counts back to baseline. Follow-up: implement import dry-run and add alerts for duplicate-id rate > 0.1%.
follow_up_tasks: - [PLT-1102] Add import dry-run and duplicate detection. - [PLT-1103] Add locale-aware numeric parsing and input validation. - [OPS-933] Reprocess reporting pipeline for 2026-03-09 window and publish corrected numbers to internal dashboards.
